reviews.title: Comfortable, Stylish, and Beautiful Color!
reviews.body: This B Power Reclining Sofa has exceeded my expectations. The PU leather feels premium and is easy to maintain, while the power reclining feature is smooth and adds to the comfort. The flipped middle backrest is perfect for holding snacks or drinks. The color is absolutely beautiful, just as described, and it adds a warm, rich tone to our living room. Assembly was straightforward, and it comfortably seats three adults. Highly recommend for anyone looking to upgrade their home theater or living space!

features: 3-Seat Power Recliner Sofa: Indulge in comfort with our electric recliner sofa. Featuring a split backrest design, each seat on both sides operates independently via power switches, granting you the freedom to recline one seat from 100° to 150° while keeping the others upright. Ideal for reading, watching TV, or enjoying a peaceful nap.Additionally, conveniently located next to the switch, you'll find a USB and Type C interface, providing easy access to charge your devices while lounging on this recliner sofa.

Timeless Elegance: Immerse yourself in the refined craftsmanship and timeless elegance of our Recliner sofa. Crafted with premium top-grade breathing leather material, this sofa exudes luxury while offering unparalleled comfort. Easy to care for and maintain, the smooth and skin-friendly surface adds a touch of sophistication to any space, ensuring lasting beauty for years to come.

Hidden Center Console: Revolutionize your lounging experience with our power recliner couch featuring a discreet hidden center console. Flip the middle backrest, and with a simple push of a button, watch as the console rises to reveal 2xAC outlets, 1xUSB-A port, and 1xType C port, fulfilling all your daily charging needs. In addition, the electric recliner sofa comes with two cup holders and two magazine storage bags for unparalleled convenience and storage for you and your family.

Maximum Stability & Safety: Our recliner sofas are framed in high-quality wood and reinforced with metal bases for unmatched stability and security. After many tests, the sofa can carry a maximum weight of 990 pounds. 8 anti-fall brackets for your safety escort, is a reliable and safe choice for your home.

Easy Assembly & Warranty: Transform your living space effortlessly with our power recliner sofa, measuring 78.74''X28.74''X42.13''. The 3 seater power recliner is sent in four boxes and takes only 15 minutes to assemble. Plus, enjoy peace of mind with our 1-year warranty covering the motor and steel frame. Contact our dedicated team for any assistance – we're here for you.
